models.image_generation_resolution: 1024x1024 in the previous comparable runner; official infra docs also report 2048x2048 serving.

models.image_generation_resolution: 432x432 for the comparable base run; HQ 512/1024 configs hit positional-token mismatch on this checkpoint.
models.generation_paradigm: Native unified multimodal transformer combining AR text modeling with flow matching for visual generation through a 3D causal VAE representation.
models.interface_space: VAE latent / causal visual tokens with flow matching
models.notes: Include both base-resolution successes and the HQ failure mode in the report, because the resolution gap affects fairness.

models.image_generation_resolution: 1024x1024 in the vLLM runner via image_area=1048576 and 1:1 aspect ratio
models.generation_paradigm: Pure next-token-prediction / autoregressive generation over discrete vision-token sequences using an Emu3.5 vision tokenizer; not the DiDA diffusion variant.
models.interface_space: discrete visual-token space decoded by the Emu3.5 vision tokenizer
models.notes: Slow because image generation is thousands of sequential visual tokens; vLLM/8x80 reduces memory pressure and helps throughput, but it remains AR.

models.image_generation_resolution: t2i_stage=3 produces about 1.0M px, normally 1024x1024 for 1:1 prompts; t2i_stage=2 is about 512x512.
models.generation_paradigm: Pure decoder-only autoregressive transformer with modality-specific MoE and multi-scale visual autoregressive / next-scale prediction. The public runner uses an Infinity VAE checkpoint for final image reconstruction.
models.interface_space: multi-scale visual AR representation decoded with Infinity VAE assets in the public release
models.notes: New model for this report. Use 8 single-GPU workers on the 8x80GB job so the install can be reused and each card holds one model instance.
